messages:
alyssa: Customer (acct: acme-inc) reports streaming responses cut to silence ~18-25s after first chunk, client reconnects then gets partial duplicate tokens. Very visible on large prompt outputs. They see 200 then silence, browser EventSource stays open but app shows stalled stream. Ticket #SUP-4729.

michael: Can you paste the original curl or client repro? is it only when traffic passes through our edge or their LB?

alyssa: Their stack: Cloudflare (spectrum) -> ALB -> nginx ingress -> our origin. Repro curl from their env: \n```\ncurl -v -N "https://redwood.example.com/v1/stream?model=gpt-x" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream"\n```\nLogs show initial chunks streaming, then an "idle timeout" trace at ALB (connection reset) followed by multiple reconnects. They also reported a billing spike from retries.

jordan: Typical suspects: ALB idle timeout (default 60s), Cloudflare buffering / http2 -> http1.1 translation, and nginx proxy_buffering. But the timeline (~20s) is interesting — could be an app-level keepalive suppressed by proxy.

sre-oncall: Quick triage checklist: check ALB idle timeout, ALB keepalive settings, Cloudflare proxy buffering and response body buffering settings, any intermediate h2->h1 gateway or envoy timeouts, and nginx proxy_buffering/x-accel buffering. Also check if response uses chunked transfer vs SSE framing.

alyssa: I attached a snippet from our origin access logs: \n```\nGET /v1/stream 200 15.4s "Accept:text/event-stream" "chunked" 1.2KB\n[stream] chunk 1 (400 bytes)\n[stream] chunk 2 (380 bytes)\n... silence ...\nconnection closed by client after 22s\n```\n
michael: Can you get tcpdump/pcap from a node behind ALB during repro? Need to see whether ALB half-close or TCP RST from client side. Also capture ingress nginx logs with request/response bytes, and enable upstream trace in nginx: \n```\nlog_format upstream '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] \"$request\" '\n 'upstream_status=$upstream_status upstream_response_time=$upstream_response_time '\n 'upstream_bytes_received=$upstream_bytes_received upstream_bytes_sent=$upstream_bytes_sent';\n```\n
alyssa: I asked customer to run `curl -v -N` and tcpdump on their app. Meanwhile tried a quick mitigation: turned off Cloudflare caching/proxy for route and bypassed ALB with direct origin test — stream stayed healthy for ~2m. So this strongly implicates edge/ALB buffering/timeouts.

jordan: For mitigation recommend: increase ALB idle timeout to 4+ minutes for that target group, set ALB "connection-termination" to preserve long-lived connections, and in nginx set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_set_header Connection ''; chunked_transfer_encoding on;` Also set `X-Accel-Buffering: no` if customers put nginx in front.

support-bot: Note: customer reported auth refresh attempts during reconnect — token TTL short (30s) -> 401 on reconnect causing duplicate partial payloads and billing retries. Escalate to billing if retries triggered usage spikes.

alyssa: Good catch — they use short-lived tokens and our client retry logic retries on transient 401 after refresh which replays part of stream. I've asked them to increase token TTL temporarily and to ensure retry dedupe.

michael: Another possible root: ALB HTTP/2 windowing + backend HTTP/1.1 conversion causing small buffered frames to stall if server doesn't flush. For Envoy/ALB edge combos we saw earlier that small writes can be held until buffer fills. Recommend server flush every chunk (e.g., call flush() in frameworks) and ensure response includes `Content-Type: text/event-stream
Cache-Control: no-cache
Connection: keep-alive`.

alyssa: Repro steps I'm asking them to run and return results: 1) curl from inside their VPC to origin bypassing ALB/cloudflare 2) curl via ALB only (disable cloudflare) 3) curl via full path 4) tcpdump on ALB target and on client 5) nginx upstream trace and enable `proxy_buffering off`.

jordan: If repro confirms ALB is closing at ~20s, create infra Jira to check for any http2->http1 connection re-use bugs and ALB health probe interactions. Add ALB logs (ELB access logs) with target_connection_termination.

sre-oncall: For next steps: (a) ask support to schedule a short maintenance window for acme to try increasing idle timeout + disabling cloudflare proxy for that domain (b) collect pcaps and ELB logs for the event window (c) add temporary rate-limiter and dedupe on retries to avoid billing spike.

alyssa: Provided them a short checklist and a sample nginx config to test: \n```\nlocation /v1/stream {\n  proxy_pass http://redwood-origin;\n  proxy_buffering off;\n  proxy_send_timeout 300s;\n  proxy_read_timeout 300s;\n  proxy_set_header Connection \"\";\n  add_header X-Accel-Buffering no;\n}\n```\n
michael: Also test with `curl --http2-prior-knowledge -v` to see if h2 behavior differs. And run `wrk` with a single connection streaming to reproduce at scale.

alyssa: Customer tested bypassing Cloudflare earlier and stream remained stable for 2 minutes, but when routed through ALB+Cloudflare it failed in ~20s. They're going to test with ALB idle timeout bump and disable http2 on ALB to see if it helps.

support-bot: Updated ticket SUP-4729: assigned to eng-infra for deeper trace, linked pcaps, ELB logs, and customer repro steps.

jordan: If ALB is the culprit and we can't change customer's ALB, we should document clear guidance in support KB: recommended ALB settings, nginx flags, and token TTL guidance for streaming endpoints. Also add an automatic health-check in Console to detect frequent midstream reconnects to alert customers earlier.

sre-oncall: I'll create the infra ticket now and tag @michael and @jordan. Let's reconvene after they attach pcaps and ELB logs. :thumbsup:
